mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and increases overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST showed a sustained increase over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and CPIAUCSL remains stable, it signals strong consumer demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and CPIAUCSL stable
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% MoM and CPIAUCSL remained stable.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 4.5% and GDPC1 QoQ growth was below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a robust supply-side expansion, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO showed a sustained increase of more than 2% over the previous three months.
